brief.summary: The Chloé girl: 70s bohemian ease with a Parisian cut — a floaty blouse or broderie dress, high-waisted flares, a wide belt, a suede or shearling jacket and a slouchy leather bag. Romantic but never sweet; the fabrics are natural, the colours sun-faded, the shoes a wedge or a boot.
signatures: floaty blouse with ruffle or pin-tuck detail
broderie anglaise or lace midi dress
wooden wedge or a chunky leather boot
silhouettes: flared leg with a tucked blouse
floaty midi dress belted at the waist
